summary: On 19 October 2026, Rotary Club of Deonar conducted Happitude, a mental health awareness programme for students of the General Education Academy Interact Club and their teachers.
description: On 19 October 2026, Rotary Club of Deonar conducted Happitude, a mental health awareness programme for students of the General Education Academy Interact Club and their teachers. The programme focused on promoting emotional well-being, mental health awareness and positive thinking. The initiative witnessed enthusiastic participation from 165 students and 60 teachers, making it a meaningful step towards building a more emotionally aware and supportive school community.
